descriptionMarkdown: This is an updated version of an older blueprint. It crafts everything that is available on Nauvis except for science packs (over 170 different items in total) Including belts, inserters, bots, ammunition, etc... Constructive critique is appreciated ;-) Input: 135 iron ore per sec 90 copper ore per sec 45 stone per sec 30 coal per sec 30 uranium ore per sec 380 oil per sec water Edits: I realised that it might be difficult to build that thing in one go especially in a new playthrough so I made a book that is more beginner friendly^^. Just overlay the blueprints while you progress. A few issues fixed especially with the uranium production, everything should work properly now. If someone finds an issue let me know. Electric furnaces and modules are now included in higher layers. Space age machines are now included in the highest layer. Added buffer chests and filters for storage chests for better sorting. Tips: I highly recommend to force stamp (Control/Shift/Left Click) the blueprints on top of each other after you align them. It changes quite a bit with each layer and that should make it easier to upgrade. If you have problems with mixed pipes, place the pipes first and the refineries second, that should resolve it. When upgrading from layer 4 to 5 and layer 6 to 7 I recommend to empty the furnaces manually because the bots probably will struggle with the plates inside of the furnaces.
title: Everything you need for Nauvis (Space Age Mall crafts over 170 items from ores to endproduct)
